principle: Summarize frozen Step-2 evidence only. No factor/window/direction/cost selection, no new risk or alpha estimation.

aggregation.factor_summary: Mean across frozen W60/W120/W252 for each factor.
aggregation.absolute_ic: Mean absolute IC across the three frozen windows.
aggregation.neutral_minus_raw_abs_ic: Neutral absolute alpha IC minus Raw absolute alpha IC.
aggregation.neutral_over_raw_abs_ic_ratio: Neutral absolute alpha IC divided by Raw absolute alpha IC.
aggregation.system_oos: Kept at window level because all-network OOS is not factor-specific.
aggregation.block_oos: Conditional block-level LOBO evidence; not factor-specific.
